700 mg vitamin A, 7 mg vitamin E, 200 mg vitamin K, 10 mg vitamin D, 80 mg ascorbic acid, 1.2 mg thiamin, 1.4 mg riboﬂavin, 1.0 mg
pyridoxine, 17 mg niacin, 5 mg pantothenic acid, 20 mg biotin, 140 mg folic acid, and 1 mg vitamin B12.
